Name: Shield Wall

Name: Phalanx Strike
Description: A disciplined thrust that drives the foe back a step.

Name: Valkyrie's Fury
Description: A warrior's cry that sets her own blows ablaze with battle-fury.

Name: Juggernaut Charge

Name: Rallying Banner
Description: Raises a banner that lights a fire under the whole war party.

Name: Jade Resolve
Description: The jade plate knits wounds shut as the battle rages on.

Name: Dark Rite
Description: A rite of shadow that scours the faithless and blinds the eye.

Name: Transmute Pain

Name: Divine Grace

Name: Field Triage

Name: Inner Peace
Description: Meditative breathing mends the monk's own wounds over time.

Name: Sage's Insight
Description: Wisdom turned to silence: the foe's tongue stills mid-spell.

Name: Benediction
Description: A blessing that mends the whole party as the fight wears on.

Name: Moonlit Recovery

Name: Arcane Ward

Name: Shadow Bolt

Name: Frost Nova

Name: Omen of Doom

Name: System Shock

Name: Elemental Fury

Name: Blood Rite

Name: Lion's Roar
Description: A roar before the charge — fury given voice.

Name: Swift Relay

Name: Whirling Ward

Name: Overclock
Description: Tunes an ally's gear for a temporary power spike.

Name: Turret Barrage

Name: Diagnostic Strike
Description: Finds the weak point in the foe's defenses and jams it.

Name: Jury-Rig
Description: A quick fix with spare parts clears whatever's ailing them.

Name: Feral Howl
Description: A primal howl that rattles every foe nearby.

Name: Flame Fang
Description: A strike wreathed in cinder.

Description: A chilling strike that slows the foe's step.

Description: A strike laced with creeping poison.

Name: Shock Fang
Description: A strike that crackles with stored current.

Name: Shadow Fang
Description: A strike from the dark that blinds the eye.

Name: Prism Fang
Description: A strike that refracts every color into none — pure force.

Name: Killing Blow
Description: A precise strike aimed at the kill.

Name: Night Stalk
Description: Strikes from darkness, leaving the foe blind to the next blow.

Name: Iaijutsu

Name: Rend
Description: Tears a wound that won't stop bleeding.

Name: Flurry

Name: Snatch
Description: Steals more than valuables — a sliver of the foe's power.

Name: Reckless Swing
Description: An all-or-nothing swing with wild strength behind it.

Name: Skull Crack
Description: A blow to the head that leaves the world spinning.

Name: Haymaker
Description: A heavy haymaker that sends the foe stumbling back.

Name: Riposte

Name: Fleche

Name: Combo Strike
Description: A disciplined one-two that finds the opening.

Name: Lance Charge
Description: A charging thrust that skewers everything in its path.

Name: Flowing Palm
Description: A redirecting palm strike that unbalances the foe.

Name: Bamboo Slam
Description: A playful-looking slam with real force behind it.

Name: Knockout Punch
Description: A finishing punch aimed for the knockout: half the time the foe stays down (asleep) until something hits it.

Name: Jab-Cross
Description: A quick one-two that keeps the pressure on.

Name: Plunder Strike
Description: A strike that loots a sliver of mana along with the blow.

Name: Masterless Cut
Description: A cut honed by a warrior with nothing left to lose.

Name: Contract Kill
Description: A professional's strike, paid extra for the hardest marks.

Name: Blitz Rush
Description: A burst of speed that rushes the Speedster back to the front of the line.

Name: Dirty Trick
Description: No rules, no referee — just an eye full of grit.

Name: Finishing Blow
Description: A clean, textbook finisher.

Name: Perfect Cut
Description: A single cut, placed with absolute precision.

Name: Enervating Touch
Description: A draining touch that withers the foe's vitality.

Name: Sacred Challenge

Name: Judgment of Warding
Description: Smite a foe with a judging blow that weighs down their every strike.

Name: Hands of Mercy
Description: Lay hands on an ally, mending their wounds and warding off their next blow.

Name: War Stomp

Name: Unstoppable Momentum
Description: Grit your teeth and barrel forward, hitting harder with every reckless step you take.

Name: Overrun
Description: Barrel through the battlefield and bulldoze one foe clear across it.

Name: Battle Cry of the Warlord
Description: Bellow down the battle line, rattling every foe in it and dragging their eyes to you.

Name: Rally Point
Description: Plant your banner arm and rally everyone beside you to strike harder.

Name: Marked for the Warband
Description: Call out a foe's weakness to the whole warband, leaving them half as quick to react.

Name: Mana Siphon
Description: Drain the arcane strength from a foe, stealing their focus and choking off their next spell.

Name: Venomous Grip
Description: Seize a foe in an iron grip laced with venom that gnaws at them long after you let go.

Name: Dark Communion
Description: Commune with the hunger inside you, feeding on the battle's violence to mend your wounds.

Name: Preemptive Ward
Description: Casts a ward before the blow lands: an ally shrugs off the next hit and mends a little besides.

Name: Cleansing Vigil
Description: Holds vigil over the whole party: mends every ally and burns away what ails them.

Name: Sanctuary Rite
Description: A drawn-out rite of sanctuary: slow to complete, but it wards and cleanses the entire party at once.

Name: Thorned Hex

Name: Harm Into Hope
Description: Twists a burst of dark magic so it scorches every enemy caught in it and knits every ally beside them.

Name: Mirrorcurse
Description: Brands a foe with a curse that dims their sight and turns their next blows astray.

Name: Guardian's Rush
Description: Closes the gap in a blink and drives the attacker off an endangered ally.

Name: Flowing Current
Description: Flows through a ready stance: mends everyone within reach and quickens the healer's own step.

Name: Covering Withdrawal
Description: Hauls a beleaguered ally back a step, out of harm's reach, mending them and clearing their head as they go.

Name: Alpha's Challenge
Description: Snarls and plants its paws, forcing every foe within reach to fix its glare on them alone.

Name: Pack Rally
Description: Nuzzles and growls encouragement at every ally who holds close, driving them to strike harder.

Name: Den Mother's Guard
Description: Hauls a bleeding packmate back from the brink and shoves them clear, standing between them and harm.

Name: Shortcut
Description: Cuts across the battle plan to hand an ally their next turn early - no wind-up, it lands the moment it is spoken.

Name: Stumbling Ground
Description: Marks a stretch of earth that fouls the footing of any foe who treads across it.

Name: Swift Swap
Description: Trades places with an ally in a blink, pulling them from danger, stepping into it instead, and shaking off whatever ailed them in the swap.

Name: Suppression Mine
Description: Lobs a sensor-mine that sparks on landing, jamming the arcane relays of anyone caught in the blast.

Name: Field Patch
Description: Slaps a jury-rigged patch kit onto an ally's wounds — crude, but it holds.

Name: Overdrive Tap
Description: Taps into a foe's arcane reserves, short-circuiting their spellwork and feeding the stolen charge back to the party's coffers.

Name: Festering Mark
Description: Brands the target with a hex sigil that festers into a spreading poison.

Name: Curse of Fate
Description: Unleashes a burst of dark fate magic for 14 dmg, doubled against any foe already marked by your curses, and spreads the hex to anything it leaves alive.

Name: Blood Harvest
Description: Detonates every curse down the row at once, draining the dying embers of each mark back into your own blood to mend you for a share of the harm done.

Name: Quickstrike
Description: A free, blade-quick spellstrike against an adjacent foe, over almost before it's cast.

Name: Overchannel
Description: A dual-woven blade-and-spell blow for 18 Arcane dmg, rising to 27 if the target was already struck in melee this round.

Name: Followthrough
Description: Spins out of the strike already casting the next: hastens your own turn and empowers the blow that follows.

Name: Trapline
Description: Seeds a line of snap-traps that jolt and hobble anything that crosses them.

Name: Ward Grid
Description: Drops a grid of ward-turrets that spark to life, rattling every foe caught inside.

Name: Resupply Drone
Description: Calls in a supply drone that mends every nearby ally and quickens their step.

Name: Wild Swing
Description: An all-out swing thrown with zero guard: it hits every foe on the eight tiles around you, heedless of the opening it leaves behind.

Name: Skull Rattle
Description: A rattling blow to the skull that leaves the foe seeing stars for two turns.

Name: Last Man Swinging
Description: Swing in every direction at once, trading all remaining caution for raw output. Hits hardest when you're bloodied and cornered.

Name: Probing Thrust
Description: A light, testing thrust meant to read the foe's guard: modest damage, but it throws their footing off for a turn.

Name: Guard Stance
Description: Settle into a textbook guard: the next blow against you is turned aside, leaving the attacker open to a counter-strike.

Name: Decisive Cut
Description: One unhurried, absolutely placed cut. Cheap to throw, but it only goes in clean once the foe's guard is already broken.

Name: Blindside
Description: Dart around to the foe's blind side before they can turn. Deals bonus damage and leaves them grasping at empty air.

Name: Hit and Run
Description: Land a quick strike and peel back out of reach before the foe can answer, trading follow-up damage for safety.

Name: Running Riot
Description: Sprint the length of a row in one breath, clipping every foe along the way and ending the dash beside whoever's left standing.

Name: Opening Jab
Description: A cheap testing jab that costs almost nothing to repeat. Land it and your next strike this turn hits harder.

Name: One-Two Flurry
Description: A disciplined one-two that finds the opening. Light on its own, but every consecutive turn you land it, the combo hits harder.

Name: Knockout Combo
Description: Spend the whole momentum meter on one finishing punch. Weak thrown cold, but it multiplies with every combo hit stacked before it.

Name: Bloodletting Bite
Description: Sink fangs into an adjacent foe, mending your own wounds with the blood and leaving a rot that festers for two turns.

Name: Dread Aura
Description: A creeping dread radiates outward, chipping at every nearby foe's resolve and slowing their steps.

Name: Soul Feast
Description: Rip the vitality from a distant foe and claim it as your own. No cost to cast, and every point drained heals you in equal measure.

Name: Riposte Thrust
Description: A probing thrust to the knee that leaves the foe's footwork a half-step slow.

Name: Exploit the Opening
Description: A blurring combination aimed squarely at whatever opening the first cut left behind.

Name: Cut the Casting Hand
Description: A precise cut to the casting hand - the foe's next spell dies in their throat.

Name: Fade Step
Description: Vanish into shadow and reappear anywhere nearby, already two steps ahead of the fight.

Name: Smoke Veil
Description: A thrown smoke bomb blossoms into choking dark, fouling the aim of everyone caught inside.

Name: Vanishing Cut
Description: A parting slash that buys its own escape - the wound slows whoever would give chase.

Name: Exploit
Description: A quick, shallow cut that leaves the wound to fester - the first link in a longer chain.

Name: Chain the Opening
Description: Strikes hardest against a foe already marked, piling a second ailment onto the first.

Name: Collect the Debt
Description: A gruesome payoff: the more a foe already suffers, the more of that stolen vitality flows back into you.

Name: Guard Break
Description: A shoulder-driven blow that staggers the foe back a full stride, opening room to keep swinging.

Name: Wide Cleave
Description: A sweeping horizontal cut that catches everyone in its arc and shoves the whole line back a step.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Grit through the pain: shrug off the next blow and patch the worst of the damage mid-fight.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Catch your breath and push through the pain, mending a modest portion of your own wounds.

Name: Sprint
Description: Dig in and push off the ground, surging ahead in the turn order for a burst of speed.

Name: Opportunist
Description: Spot the opening and take it: a quick strike against any foe already within arm's reach.

Name: Guard Stance
Description: Plant your feet and raise your guard, shrugging off a slice of incoming damage for a turn.

Name: Adrenaline Rush
Description: Flood your veins with adrenaline, acting sooner and hitting harder for one reckless burst.

Name: Focus Breath
Description: Settle your breathing into a steady rhythm, knitting your wounds closed turn after turn.

Name: Disengage
Description: Pivot and step back fast, putting clean distance between you and the nearest threat.

Name: Feint
Description: Feint low, then jab high: a light hit that leaves the foe grasping at afterimages.

Name: Bolster
Description: Shout encouragement across the line, steeling one ally's resolve and sharpening their next strikes.

Name: Shake It Off
Description: Grit your teeth and shrug off the pain, clearing your head of every lingering affliction.

Name: Last Stand
Description: Refuse to fall: steady yourself, shake off the hurt, and brace hard for what comes next.

Name: Pressure Point
Description: Jab a nerve cluster with precise aim, sapping a foe's footwork for a few steps.

Name: Quickshot
Description: A fast, precise shot at any foe in sight — never needs to close the distance.

Name: Called Shot
Description: Calls a shot down the whole line, catching every foe standing in it.

Name: Suppressing Fire
Description: Rakes a column with covering fire, grit kicked up blinding anyone caught in it.

Name: Piercing Shot
Description: A patient hag's curse finds the one gap in any foe's guard.

Name: Snare Shot
Description: A thorn-barbed hex that digs in and slows the leg it strikes.

Name: Deadeye Shot
Description: A patient, perfectly placed shot that hits harder than a called one.

Name: Piercing Volley
Description: A shot that punches clean through, catching the whole column behind the mark.

Name: Execution Shot
Description: A called shot held one beat too long for anything but the kill.

Name: Binding Shot
Description: A weighted bolt that fouls a foe's footing.

Name: Pitfall Volley
Description: A spread of snares dropped across a square of ground.

Name: Snare Net
Description: A weighted net that fouls a foe's footing and stops its voice along with its feet.

Name: Covering Volley
Description: Fire down a column to keep a whole lane honest: everything in it is driven back on the timeline.

Name: Retreat Shot
Description: A shot loosed while falling back, never losing the range advantage.

Name: Rapid Barrage
Description: A full quiver loosed down the line in one breath.

Name: Heavy Armor Proficiency
Description: Earns the right to wear heavy plate and mail, regardless of class.

Name: Martial Weapons
Description: Earns the right to wield any weapon in the armory, regardless of class.

Name: Arcane Focus
Description: Sharpens a hand not born to the arcane, regardless of class.

Name: Hinder
Description: Wraps a foe in heavy, sticky time: its turn icon slides back a third of the bar. No damage.

Name: Stasis
Description: Freezes the whole enemy line in the same heartbeat: every foe slides back on the timeline. No damage.

Name: Haste Field
Description: A humming field that hurries the whole party: every ally slides forward on the timeline.

Name: Drain Life
Description: 12 Dark dmg to a foe, and the stolen vitality mends the caster.

Name: Undertow
Description: 6 Ice dmg down a column; every foe in it is soaked (Wet) and dragged two tiles toward the caster.

Name: Drench
Description: Instant: soaks every foe in a 3x3 (Wet) - Lightning then shocks them for x1.5, Fire steams it off. No damage.

Name: Flame Lance
Description: 12 Fire dmg along the whole row + burning; thaws the frozen and steams off the wet.

Name: Grappling Hook
Description: Hurl a hook at a foe in sight: 6 dmg and it is reeled up to three tiles in, toward you.

Name: Meditate
Description: Still the breath and gather the field's scattered mana: one orb lands in the bank.

Name: Shove
Description: Plant a shoulder in an adjacent foe and drive it two tiles back - no blade, but walls and bodies still hurt.

Name: Disrupt
Description: A sharp word of unmaking at a foe in sight: it is silenced and its turn (or its spell) slips back.

Name: Pinning Shot
Description: 8 dmg to a foe in sight, and the arrow pins it: its next turn slides back.
